tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search for Drive files using a structured query (syntax: query_term operator values). Combine clauses with and, or, not, and parentheses.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of files to return per page.

excludeContentSnippets.description: If true, exclude the content snippet from the response.

tools.name: get_file_metadata
tools.description: Find general metadata about a user's Drive file. If the file is not found, try search_files.

fileId.description: The ID of the file to retrieve.

excludeContentSnippets.description: If true, exclude the content snippet from the response.

tools.name: read_file_content
tools.description: Fetches a natural-language text version of a Drive file and, optionally, its comments.

fileId.description: The ID of the file to retrieve.

includeComments.description: Whether to include comments inlined in the text.

tools.name: download_file_content
tools.description: Download the content of a Drive file as a base64 encoded string. Google-native files need exportMimeType.

fileId.description: The ID of the file to retrieve.

exportMimeType.description: For Google native files, the MIME type to export to.

tools.name: create_file
tools.description: Create or upload a file to Google Drive. Folders are created with MIME type application/vnd.google-apps.folder.

contentMimeType.description: MIME type of the uploaded content; required when content is provided.

parentId.description: The ID of the file's parent folder.

disableConversionToGoogleType.description: Keep the uploaded MIME type instead of converting to a Google type.

tools.name: copy_file
tools.description: Copies an existing Drive file, optionally giving the copy a new title and parent folder.

fileId.description: The ID of the file to copy.

title.description: Title of the new file; defaults to 'Copy of [original title]'.

parentId.description: Parent folder of the new file; defaults to the original's parent.

tools.name: list_recent_files
tools.description: Find recent files for a user in a specified sort order. Default sort order is recency.

tools.name: get_file_permissions
tools.description: List the permissions of a Drive file.

fileId.description: The ID of the file to get permissions for.
